subject.title: fix(sessions_send): omit misleading delivery.status from async A2A responses (#96020)

question: Should normal async sessions_send A2A responses omit delivery metadata, or should OpenClaw define explicit non-misleading status values for this response contract?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but changing or redefining delivery.status is compatibility-sensitive and the sibling candidate proposes different semantics for the same issue.

options.title: Accept omission after proof
options.body: Use this PR's omitted-field shape for normal async A2A paths, preserve skipped for skipped A2A, and require real OpenClaw proof before merge.

options.title: Define explicit statuses instead
options.body: Pause this PR and sponsor a contract that names only observable states, with docs and proof covering each status.

options.title: Keep pending for compatibility
options.body: Reject the response-contract change and leave the misleading pending field until a fuller delivery-tracking design exists.

recommendation.title: Accept omission after proof
recommendation.body: Use this PR's omitted-field shape for normal async A2A paths, preserve skipped for skipped A2A, and require real OpenClaw proof before merge.
